purpose: reproduce the seed231 P1/1401 failure in serial mode with serial parent controls, without changing the C1 score

protocol.evaluator: exact frozen C1 evaluator/wrapper and source hashes
protocol.changes_allowed: new output_dir and external diagnostic manifest only; base C1 phase metadata can remain; no child numerical-code edits
protocol.argv: derive original configuration.json argv, replace output_dir only; record runnable command and environment
protocol.all_settings: same observation noise on, native std, TF32off, reset wrench0, push off, dt.02, actual checkpoint, script/URDF/versions/RNG as original
protocol.other_GPU_sim_or_training_processes: must be absent; if busy do not kill unrelated jobs, report resource_blocked

comparison.parent_controls: compare old C1 parent231 D/S to new serial D/S; record exact equality and first numerical divergence, initial physical/RNG equality required
comparison.parent_numerical_difference_only: do not claim exact equivalence; retain differences; remaining P1 diagnoses descriptive only unless protocol mismatch
comparison.P1_diagnostics: compare original C1 four-lane231 D/S to new serial; terminal step, base-contact peak, body tilt, action/state first divergence and maximal absolute difference on common prefix

decision.serial_reproduces_base_contact: failure exists without four-lane scheduling; candidate not suitable for continuation; keep parent
decision.serial_both_survive: mode/numerical/running-conditions sensitivity remains; not proof original failure invalid; require separately budgeted balanced comparison before conclusions
decision.mixed_or_nonidentical: report uncertainty and per-case evidence; no automatic training
decision.parent_config_physics_RNG_mismatch: stop immediately, do not infer mode cause

budget.effective_deadline: min(T0+900, fixed finish12:45UTC, verified lease expiry minus90min)

stops.technical_failure: preserve log and stop this small diagnostic; do not spend time looping restarts
stops.actual_base_contact: valid diagnostic result, not a technical retry
stops.no_time_for_all4_and_archive: budget_blocked or incomplete; no selection from subset

deliverables: 4 separate raw trajectories and configuration/frozen/initial/RNG fingerprints
original-vs-diagnostic state/action comparisons with event timing and contact
model/source SHA before and after, update count0 from evaluation-only source
serial GPU process isolation evidence, runtime and technical status
diagnostic-results.json separate from immutable C1 results, raw archive and external hash check, fixed commit
future_training: not issued by this plan; if a later experiment is proposed, do not automatically continue these R7P candidates or reuse231-235 as unseen tests
